title: Personal Checking: The Maintenance Charge Examined in a Same-Day Waiver Review
content:
## Rule

In the same-day waiver review of a Personal Checking account, the charge examined is the monthly maintenance charge that was booked to the account on the current business day. A maintenance charge from an earlier day is not the subject of this review.

If the review ends in a refund, the refund is for the whole of that charge, at exactly the amount the charge entry shows, and never for a portion of it; it is recorded as a bank-error correction. A charge that already carries a refund entry is never refunded a second time.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input found in the account activity | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| a monthly maintenance charge booked today, no refund entry against it | this charge is the one reviewed | any refund equals its full booked amount |
| a monthly maintenance charge booked today, already refunded | no second refund is possible | nothing |
| no monthly maintenance charge booked today | nothing to review under this rule | nothing |

## Hypothetical example

An account shows a monthly maintenance charge of 18.00 USD (an illustrative figure) booked on the cycle closing date, which is today, with no refund entry against it. That charge is the one examined; if the review finds a waiver met, 18.00 USD is refunded, not a prorated part.

The amount is kept to two decimal places, so no rounding enters the refund.
